issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type double, but the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) defines the method as returning int (signature: public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()). This mismatch between the exercise specification and the solution will confuse students about the expected return type and whether the division should be floating-point or integer, and can cause test or grading mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the UML and tests by changing the method signature and implementation to return a double and perform floating-point division. For example, in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java change the signature to: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); } Also update any template hint/comments and tests/documentation to expect a double return type so students and automated checks are consistent.
